recipes.name: Spicy Sausage Ragu
ingredients_raw: 1 pound spicy Italian sausage, casing removed

steps.text: Cook sausage in a Dutch oven over medium heat until browned, about 15 minutes. Stir in parsley; cook for 2 minutes. Stir in wine; cook until nearly evaporated, 3 to 5 minutes.
Increase heat to high; stir in heavy cream and bring to a boil. Stir in tomato sauce and water; return to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer sauce for 1 hour.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add penne, return to a boil, and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes; drain.
Stir penne into sauce to combine. Remove from heat, cover, and let sit about 2 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Spicy Sausage Ragu
raw_recipe.description: This spicy sausage ragu recipe features Italian sausage and a simple tomato sauce with white wine, cream, and fresh parsley for a zesty pasta dinner.

review.reviewBody: No dutch oven, just a plain ol' cast iron skillet. I made one small change. I don't normally keep parsley on hand (and I forgot to pick it up this week during the grocery shopping) so instead of parsley, I added two teaspoons of homemade italian seasoning. This ragu was cake, seriously 20 minutes it took me to make this, not counting the simmering. The end result was fantastic. My husband and kids INHALED this dish--there was NO leftovers. I'll make this again.

We love this dish, have made it several times. We did add sautéed garlic & onions when cooking the meat (we use turkey Italian sausage), also add a small can of diced tomatoes with green chiles. Serve it with fried eggplant, perfect!

I love this recipe. I made my own marinara sauce by simmering tomatoes and garlic (with a pinch of sugar) for about 30 minutes then added to the sausage. Everyone loved it and licked the bowls clean. You will not regret. :-)

just tried this for the first time. I did make a few additions though, along with the sausage I added some pepperoni and prosciutto and used a spicy marinara sauce. I also used 1 of the home made pasta recipe from this site. it was absolutely DELICIOUS. I would highly recommend it.

Absolutely delicious! I used up leftovers from pizza night to make this and I was shocked at how good it turned out. The husband was not a fan of the Italian sausage on his pizza but turns out he loved it in this pasta. I used leftover Chef John pizza sauce so I need to adjust the seasonings a little but the slow simmer resulted in a great depth of flavor. When I put the pasta in I thought the sauce was too thin but the starch in the pasta thickened it up perfectly. Thanks, Chef John!

We absolutely love this recipe. It's on our regular rotation. Great as is, but to make it a little healthier I use ground turkey and add Penzey's Italian Sausage Seasoning while using Tinkyada pasta which is made from brown rice. Delicious!

Phenomenal!! I made this with Chef John's recipe for tomato sauce and it just could not have been better. I did not have spicy sausage so I added some red pepper flakes and also some cayenne for good measure. Served with rigatoni. We loved it. I think that 1/4 cup of cream takes it over the top.

Very delicious but watch the salt in this one. I used chicken and turkey sausage to make it a bit healthier. I used rigatoni and I think it's a better option than penne pasta because it fit with the sausage.

This has become my new favorite easy pasta dish. My two young daughters and my husband loved it. I used Barilla Marinara sauce for the tomato sauce. That combined with the white wine and heavy cream made for a delicious, but not too heavy cream sauce. I didn't have fresh parsley, so I used 1 tablespoon of dried parsley. I will be making this again, ....very soon. Thanks Chef John for another fantastic dish!

So I come home from work one night and my husband says he has dinner taken care of. The house smells amazing, but yet I was still a little worried because the husband is not a make dinner from scratch sort of guy. I was glad he found this recipe. It was the first of many we've made from Chef John. In fact we've made it so many times I don't even have to look at the recipe anymore. I've made it with wine and also with chicken stock and a little cider vinegar and we like it both ways.
I didnot have fresh parsley. I subed 2tsp. of dried Italian seasoning for the parsley because that is what I had. This recipe is fantastic. Make it, you won't be sorry.

This is very good. I did add a few diced veggies and used milk instead of cream. Came out excellent. I was surprised at how creamy and well seasoned this was - I guess that I had good sausages. Leftovers froze well.

So good I can't even. Followed to the letter. Chef John is the bomb! 

Hint: try it with arborio. Yum!

I just made this tonight. I followed the recipe exactly as written except I used regular ground beef instead of sausage and served it over spaghetti. I only did this because I am desperately trying to find foods that my very picky 3-year old will eat and I didn’t want it to be too flavourful as she tends to like milder foods. My daughter, hubby and myself loved this. I used Newman’s Marinara Sauce for the tomato sauce. I highly recommend this recipe. This is definitely the sauce recipe I am going to use from now on for spaghetti, lasagna, etc. And I have tried ALOT!

6.17.19 ... https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/222001/spicy-sausage-ragu/ ... Good, but not special. E, 22, thought it was too tomatoey, liked all, but this one was last place of the three I tried; this, Christine L's Amatriciana & Ellen's Arrabbiata Sauce.
This was just full of awesomeness. Very hearty, easy, and delicious. I slow simmered for about 1 1/2 hours but I think it could go longer and just keep getting better.
Tomato sauce is not interchangeable with jar pasta sauce. The recipe should not say tomato sauce.
my boys liked this recipe but they weren't crazy about it!

I used a skillet to cook everything, not a dutch oven. I used dried italian spice mix instead of parsley, and doubled the recipe as I'm feeding 5 hungry people. It was fantastic, and everyone loved it!
This sauce is so easy and delicious! Please try this, you won't be sorry!
